scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web -w mobile -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.serve: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run start -w server
